headline: Site Reliability Engineer | Automation and Monitoring
summary: Results-oriented Site Reliability Engineer with a passion for building and maintaining robust, scalable systems. Proven ability to automate infrastructure processes, implement comprehensive monitoring solutions, and ensure high availability for critical applications. Eager to contribute to a dynamic team and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

bullets: Reduced system downtime by 25% through proactive infrastructure monitoring and automated incident response systems.
Developed and implemented a comprehensive Kubernetes monitoring strategy using Prometheus and Grafana, resulting in a 15% decrease in incident resolution time.
Automated routine infrastructure tasks using Go scripts, freeing up 10% of the DevOps team's time for more complex projects.
Successfully migrated 5 critical web applications to AWS, improving application performance by 10% and reducing infrastructure costs by 8%.
Created and maintained comprehensive documentation for AWS infrastructure configurations, ensuring seamless onboarding for new team members.
Collaborated with developers to implement CI/CD pipelines, reducing application deployment time by 20%.
